metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: History & Culture core includes Introduction to Music & Society (HMU111H1), Historical Survey HMU125H1, Historical Survey HMU226H1, and one elective HMU course of the student's choice.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Jazz students complete HMU111H1 and HMU126H1, followed by Jazz History courses JMU210H1 and JMU215H1.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Classical Theory core consists of TMU105/TMU107Y1, TMU130H1, TMU131H1, TMU132H1, TMU133H1, TMU230H1*, TMU231H1*, and TMU232H1* (asterisk indicates not required for Music Technology & Digital Media specialists).

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Jazz Theory core consists of JMU100Y1, JMU101Y1, JMU104Y1, JMU191Y1* (not required for Interdisciplinary Music Studies, Music Education, or Music Technology & Digital Media), JMU200Y1** (not required for Music Technology & Digital Media), JMU201Y1** (not required for Music Technology & Digital Media), and JMU291Y1* (not required for Interdisciplinary Music Studies, Music Education, or Music Technology & Digital Media).

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Music Technology & Digital Media specialists replace 200-level TMU and JMU courses with DMU200Y1 (musical acoustics and psychoacoustics) and DMU201H1 (technical ear training).

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Performance core requires participation in major vocal or instrumental ensembles and individual instruction, except Music Technology & Digital Media students who must participate in electronic music ensembles.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Core Music courses (shown in bold in program charts) must be taken in the specified year, cannot be dropped, and if a student fails a Core Music course they must retake it the next academic session; failure to retake results in a zero for the course.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: A Music Elective is any Faculty of Music course (excluding Core Music courses) that is not required for the specific program.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Students must complete a minimum of 4.0 credits in Breadth Electives, except the History, Culture & Theory specialization which requires 5.0 credits and the Interdisciplinary Studies program which permits up to 8.0 credits.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Within Breadth Electives, at least 3.0 credits must be from Faculty of Arts & Science courses (minimum 4.0 credits for the History, Culture & Theory specialization). One credit may be from a prescribed list of academic Music courses. The Breadth Elective requirement does not apply to Artist Diploma programs.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Within the 20.0 credit requirement, students must also complete 0.5 credits of a Genre/Style requirement from a prescribed list of courses.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Students are responsible for meeting all published prerequisites; registration in courses without meeting prerequisites may be cancelled without warning.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Students may transfer to another option within the same genre (Classical or Jazz) after the end of Year 1, but the time required to complete the degree may be extended.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Exploratory Year students are encouraged to choose courses from their intended program; these courses count toward program requirements if the student continues in that specialization, otherwise they count as Music Electives.

source.title: Bachelor of Music | Faculty of Music

metadata.chunk_title: The Curriculum + Minor Programs within the Faculty of Music

facts.value: Minor programs are offered in History and Culture, Composition, and Historical Keyboard.

facts.value: A Minor substitutes for the Music Electives required for the student's degree/diploma, but completing a Minor is not required for graduation.
